assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina TruSeq stranded total RNA, HiSeq 2500), quadriceps of adult female offspring

grp: MHE (maternal HF, dam ran voluntarily during gestation)
PHE (paternal HF, dam ran during gestation)

inclusion: 15 female offspring, n=3 per group (GEO overall design: '3 samples per groups'); NC-Sed shared control for maternal (Study 1) and paternal (Study 2) lines (GEO treatment protocol)
primary_estimand: Effect of maternal voluntary wheel running during gestation on adult female offspring skeletal-muscle transcriptome under parental high-fat diet: MHE vs MHS (maternal HF line) and PHE vs PHS (paternal HF line)
planned_contrasts: grp_MHE_vs_MHS: maternal exercise within maternal-HF line (abstract: 'maternal exercise resulted in a transcriptional profile similar to offspring from NC-fed parents'; paper count not in abstract)
grp_PHE_vs_PHS: maternal exercise within paternal-HF line (same abstract sentence)
grp_MHS_vs_NCS and grp_PHS_vs_NCS: parental HF vs NC (abstract: profiles 'enriched in genes regulating inflammation and immune responses')
grp_MHE_vs_NCS and grp_PHE_vs_NCS: does exercise bring HF offspring back toward NC (abstract: 'similar to NC')
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.11.8 'for maternal and paternal lines separately' (GEO data_processing; full methods not available)
paper_results: Abstract: HF (maternal or paternal) offspring muscle enriched in inflammation/immune genes; maternal exercise gave a profile similar to NC offspring. No DEG counts or named genes in the abstract (Pgc-1a named only for promoter methylation).
